messages:
Maya: Quick coordination check — final weights path for nebula v3.1 is s3://redwood-models/releases/nebula/v3.1/nebula-v3.1-8bit.pt ? I also noticed tokenizer_special_tokens.json in the bundle is different from the onboarding spec (extra tokens). I'm about to push the serve config, want to avoid breaking kv-cache keying.

Samir: Confirmed, that s3 path is the one we'll serve from. ACLs should allow inference-serving role read access. Tokenizer change was intentional to add a couple func tokens (we hit a tool-calling edgecase).

AJ: FYI I ran the golden prompts against the canary and the function/tool-call outputs are failing schema checks — our harness expects tool_response to be an object but the runtime returned a string in some cases. I'll add a stricter fuzzer.

ci-bot: CI: model-pack validation \u2714 passed. token-check \u274C failed: unknown token at index 1245 in tokenizer_special_tokens.json diff. See logs: https://ci.redwood/tests/4221

Liz: The tokenizer addition is <|func_start|> / <|func_end|>. We needed them so the model can emit structured tool-call wrappers. Make sure serve config maps them under special_tokens. Also heads-up: merges changed token ids — that can shift kv-cache indices.

Nate: For the serve config, use this snippet and double-check special_tokens mapping before deploy:

```yaml
model_name: nebula-v3.1
weights_path: s3://redwood-models/releases/nebula/v3.1/nebula-v3.1-8bit.pt
quantize: true
special_tokens:
  func_start: "<|func_start|>"
  func_end: "<|func_end|>"
runtime_flags:
  kv_cache_mode: keyed
```

Maya: Thanks. I'll hold the canary until AJ's schema fix lands and perms are confirmed. Also can someone drop the golden prompts list for regressions? I want to run the structured-output suite before promoting.

AJ: Adding an integration test to exercise function calling with structured output now — will push in PR #3721. It includes one golden prompt that expects: `{\n  \"tool_call\": {\n    \"name\": \"lookup\",\n    \"arguments\": {\n      \"id\": \"1234\"\n    }\n  }\n}`

Samir: Permissions reminder: ensure inference-serving role has s3:GetObject on the weights path and kms:Decrypt for the key. I'll check IAM after this thread.

ops-bot: Scheduled canary 10% for service `nebula-v3.1` at 2024-11-02T18:00Z. :rocket:

Liz: Note — because merges added tokens, the tokenizer now shifts IDs by +3 for tokens after index 512. We need a small runtime patch to offset legacy kv-cache keys. I'll open INF-129 and link to runtime PR.

Maya: Sounds good. Plan: wait for AJ's PR (+1 test), Samir verifies IAM, CI green on e2e-toolcall, then canary 10% -> monitor golden diff. ETA EOD for me.

Samir: I'll also validate structured outputs against the golden set tonight. Example expected tool output shape: `{ \"action\": \"lookup\", \"args\": { \"id\": \"1234\" } }` — no extra wrapper string.

AJ: Test sample I'm adding to the harness:

```json
{
  "id": "gold-001",
  "prompt": "Find user 1234 and return a tool_call JSON",
  "expected": {
    "tool_call": {
      "name": "lookup",
      "arguments": { "id": "1234" }
    }
  }
}
```

ci-bot: CI run for PR #3721: unit + lint \u2714, integration (e2e-toolcall) flaky \u26A0, rerun scheduled.

ops-bot: Rerun queued for PR #3721.

Samir: Once AJ's fix and CI pass, let's unpin the old tokenizer and flip the canary. I'll watch for golden diffs and kv-cache errors. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
